prompts.title: Reading Under a Tree by the Water
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, highly detailed golden hour photograph of a handsome man, sitting in lush, tall green grass by the edge of a serene lake. He is seen in a medium profile shot, facing left. He is wearing a cozy, oversized off-white knit sweater with thin horizontal black stripes and light beige trousers. A delicate silver chain necklace is subtly visible at his collar. His expression is contemplative, peaceful, and focused as he holds an open book with one hand, reading intently. The lighting is cinematic golden hour sunlight streaming from the upper left, casting a beautiful golden rim light on his hair, and the edges of the book's pages, while subtle natural bounce lighting gently illuminates his face, ensuring balanced exposure with no underexposed shadows and preserving clear facial details. The background features a tranquil lake with subtle ripples, reflecting the surrounding nature. Across the water, there is a lush bank lined with tall, slender poplar trees and dense green foliage. A large tree branch with bright green leaves overhangs from the top of the frame, creating a natural vignette. Shot on a 50mm lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the subject's face and the knit texture of the sweater, with a soft, dreamy bokeh effect on the distant trees and water. 8k resolution, highly detailed, photorealistic.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5.

prompts.title: Vintage Style Woman Reading Portrait
prompts.prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic three-quarter-length portrait captured from a gentle three-quarter angle. Use the attached reference photo for facial identity and preserve facial structure and proportions. A beautiful woman sits quietly on a weathered wooden park bench beside an aged, dark muted brick wall with sparse climbing vines, peacefully reading an open brown hardcover book held in both hands. She is wearing a muted sky-blue saree with tiny white floral prints and a plain blue border, paired with a simple white blouse. Her hair is softly styled back with a red flower tucked behind one ear, finished with delicate pearl earrings. She looks down at the book with a calm, thoughtful expression. A few dry leaves drift gently through the air around her. Use subdued natural daylight with soft highlights and deep gentle shadows, creating a quiet, moody vintage courtyard atmosphere. Keep the colors slightly desaturated and earthy, with muted blue fabric, dark green foliage, weathered brown wood, and a dim brown-gray brick wall. The composition keeps her face, saree texture, and open book in sharp focus while keeping the background softly blurred but not bright or golden. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: The Autumn Reader
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic cinematic 4:5 portrait of a reference man seated on a glossy black wooden slatted park bench in an autumn park. Frame him from head to upper legs/knees, seated slightly left of center, with the bench stretching diagonally across the foreground. Do not make it a full-body shot and do not show the feet.

The man has sharp, youthful features, natural skin tone, thick, neatly styled hair with soft volume, and classic black-rimmed eyeglasses with slightly rounded rectangular lenses. He is wearing a fitted solid black short-sleeve t-shirt and clean white trousers, with realistic fabric texture, natural folds, and subtle highlights.

Pose and expression: He sits in a relaxed, quiet reading posture, body angled slightly sideways instead of front-facing. His head is gently tilted downward, eyes focused on the open book in his hands. Both hands hold the book naturally near his lap, with realistic fingers and grip. His expression is calm, focused, introspective, and intelligent, as if deeply absorbed in reading.

Environment: A peaceful autumn park with warm golden, amber, and orange foliage in the background. The background should be strongly blurred with creamy bokeh, soft circular highlights, and dark vertical tree trunks creating depth. Fallen autumn tones should softly appear behind and around the bench, but the subject remains the sharp focus.

Lighting and mood: Soft diffused natural daylight with a warm autumn glow. Gentle highlights on his hair, face, glasses, arms, black shirt, white trousers, and book pages. Use subtle shadows for depth, realistic skin texture, natural color grading, and a serene cinematic mood.

Camera style: full-frame camera look, 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, f/1.4, ISO 100, 1/200s, sharp subject with creamy background blur. Ultra-realistic details, high dynamic range, premium cinematic portrait photography.

Negative prompt: no full-body shot, no visible feet, no direct front-facing pose, no harsh flash, no extra people, no distorted hands, no deformed book, no unreadable messy fingers, no over-smoothed plastic skin, no cartoon or painting style, no extreme wide-angle distortion.

prompts.title: Refuge in the Rubble
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image ONLY for face and identity reference. Do not alter facial structure, skin tone, age details, hairstyle, or natural features. Preserve exact identity with realistic skin texture and imperfections.
Create a hyper-realistic, cinematic full-body portrait of the subject sitting on worn brick steps inside an abandoned, partially ruined building.
Composition (LOCKED):

Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio

Full-body framing (feet clearly visible)

Subject centered slightly toward left, side profile

Natural depth with visible background structure
Pose:

Seated on brick steps

Body slightly leaning forward

Elbows resting loosely on thighs

Both hands holding an open book

Head slightly tilted downward, eyes focused on the book

Expression calm, introspective, slightly serious
Environment:

Old, abandoned building interior with broken walls and exposed bricks

Large open window spaces allowing daylight inside

Rough textures: cracked plaster, weathered bricks, debris on floor

Background should feel raw, empty, and atmospheric (no clutter distraction)
Lighting:

Soft natural daylight coming from the side (window direction)

Gentle shadows with realistic falloff

Subtle highlights on face, hands, and book

No harsh artificial lighting
Outfit:

Rugged casual style —

Layered hoodie inside

Worn leather or canvas jacket (earth tones like brown/orange)

Faded cargo or denim pants

Brown leather boots (slightly worn)
Style & Rendering:

Ultra-realistic photography style

Cinematic color grading (slightly desaturated, earthy tones)

High detail in textures (skin, fabric, bricks)

No AI artifacts, no over-smoothing

Natural imperfections preserved

prompts.title: Retro Vintage Autumn Book Reading
prompts.prompt:
Cinematic 4:5 aspect-ratio night portrait of a young woman standing beneath a vintage black iron street lamp, reading an open hardcover book with a plain tan cloth cover. She has long, naturally wavy hair blowing dramatically to the side in the wind, eyes cast down toward the page, calm and absorbed expression, small hoop earring. She wears a loose dusty-mauve long-sleeve button-up blouse tucked into high-waisted cream pleated trousers.
Nighttime scene, the glowing street lamp is the sole light source, casting warm amber volumetric light rays that streak diagonally through the dark hazy air and illuminate her face and the pages of the book. Deep shadowy taupe-brown backdrop with soft painterly texture fading into darkness at the edges, like a dimly lit studio set. Scattered golden-orange autumn leaves drift and swirl through the air around her, slightly motion-blurred, catching the lamplight. Warm tonal palette of amber, burnt sienna, mauve, and cream against dark surroundings. Soft night mist in the atmosphere.
Retro, vintage-inspired editorial night photography, 1940s-meets-modern aesthetic, film grain, shallow depth of field, medium shot from waist up, subject slightly right of center with the lamp post on the left. Moody, nostalgic, romantic evening atmosphere. Shot on 85mm lens, f/2, low-key lighting, single practical light source from upper left, warm rim light on hair, dark vignette. Highly detailed, photorealistic, 8k.
